questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some tabs are medicines.

Some tabs are ointments.

Some medicines are branches.

Conclusions:

(I): Some tabs are branches.

(II): Some medicines are ointments.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7064c85c3b538be2d9aeb5ad45c0f8605bc717909df736254102a4cb9bfa2af.png] 

Conclusions:**
(I): Some tabs are branches. - False(As their is no relation between tabs and branches may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II): Some medicines are ointments.- False (As their is no relation between medicines and ointments may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**

questions.question:

questions.solution:

791 + 9 = 800

800 + 8 = 808

808 + 7 = 815

So next, the difference should be 6.​​​

815 + 6 = 821​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"**

questions.question: Each of the digits in the number 78152469 is arranged in ascending order from left to right. Which of the following digits will be fourth from the left?
questions.solution:
Digits of 78152469 :

7, 8, 1, 5, 2, 4, 6, 9

Arranged in ascending order (left to right):

**1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9**

Fourth digit from the left = 5

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
